scheme_name: Incentives to Encourage Consumption of Local Raw Material Scheme, 2008
other_conditions: Units must have gone into production on or after 6th August 2008
Units must be under green or specified orange categories
Units must be permanently registered with the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce or cleared by the High Powered Co‑ordination Committee or any other authorized committee
Units must be Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprises as defined under the MSMED Act
Units must consume a minimum of 50% of raw material value from local sources (60%+ for full benefit)
Units must provide documentary evidence proving the raw material was locally produced or mined
Interpretation of eligibility clauses is final and binding by the Director, Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
benefits_summary: Up to 90% reimbursement of sales tax and a 25% subsidy on power and water bills (capped at ₹2,00,000 per year) based on the proportion of local raw material consumed.
documents_required: Specified proforma obtained from the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (or downloaded from the official website)
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Documentary evidence proving that the raw material was locally produced or mined
